title: A6 output file: ncert/pairs/<CHAPTER>.json
description: A6 has no dedicated agent (SCRIPT pair_passages.py + shared x-adjudicator for weak pairs only). This schema is the output FILE shape per Section 6.4: 'list of {old_passage_id, new_passage_id, similarity, result: pair|removed|added, adjudicated}'. The file itself is a JSON array at top level, one entry per older passage, per latest passage, or per matched pair (every passage of the chapter is exactly one of pair/removed/added, per the A6 check).

old_passage_id.description: null when result is 'added' (no older-edition partner).

new_passage_id.description: null when result is 'removed' (no latest-edition partner).

similarity.description: Jaccard similarity on word 3-grams after normalise_quote. >= 0.85 pair; 0.50-0.85 weak (goes to adjudicator); < 0.50 for all candidates -> removed/added.

adjudicated.description: True when a weak pair (0.50-0.85) went to x-adjudicator. On-failure default: weak + unsure still keeps 'pair' (A6_WEAK_PAIR, normal).
